description.narrative: SUMMARY Since the outbreak of the Tigray conflict in November 2020, the humanitarian needs in Ethiopia have rapidly escalated. This Joint Response aims to address life-saving humanitarian needs of IDPs and conflict-affected populations in the Northern Region of Ethiopia, specifically Tigray, Amhara and Oromia. The project is implemented by a consortium of 6 partners, who will cover the sectors of FSL, WASH, Health, Protection, Education, relying on MPCA wherever feasible. Plan will focus on WASH and Education interventions, supported by its local partner MCMDO who will intervene in the Health sector. The project is expected to reach 360,123 beneficiaries, and Plan will specifically target 137,612 people in need, with a focus on girls, boys, adolescent girls and other vulnerable groups.
